links.quote: Minimal transparency diagnoses had a 73.9% override rate compared to 49.3% for moderate transparency.

The implementation of this framework reduced the override rate to 33.29%, with high-confidence predictions (90-99%) overridden at a rate of only 1.7%, and low-confidence predictions (70-79%) at a rate of 99.3%.

links.effect: Overall override rate was 33.29%: 2227 of 6689 cases; 4462 non-overrides.
links.quote: The Overall Override rate across all AI-generated CVDs was 33.29% (2227 out of 6689 cases, non-override cases: 4462), indicating that approximately one-third of the diagnoses were overridden upon clinical review.
